pushRows.sourceState: handleAutomationDispatchRequest destructures {automation, run, dispatchToken}: resolves workspace (missing repo -> markDispatchResult skipped_unavailable, no tab), prepares worktree, then reuse-session branch (findReusableAutomationSession, submitPromptToAgentPty, observeExistingAutomationSession, dispatched result with terminalSessionId/paneKey/ptyId) or fresh launchAgentBackgroundSession; background-safe (restores prior focus, never navigates); catch-all marks dispatch_failed. Replies via automations:markDispatchResult (separate invoke, not this push). Hook useAutomationDispatchEvents (10 lines) subscribes once on mount, calls rendererReady, returns disposer.
pushRows.cancellationErrorHost: Non-ok target (target.ok false) persists skipped_unavailable with target.error and never sends. Headless dispatcher path runs with no window and no send (runHeadlessAutomationDispatch). Renderer-unready with no headless persists skipped_unavailable NO_DISPATCH_HOST, no send. Update-write rejections propagate from requestDispatch caller (not caught here). Dispatch token minted per send (30-min TTL, prune on create); token reservation/expiry enforced at markDispatchResult time, not in this send. Producer owned by AutomationService instance (main). Target selected by resolveAutomationRunTarget with allowRemoteHostScheduling; renderer readiness gates send (canDispatchToRenderer: live webContents + rendererReady flag). Consumer resolves workspace from store repos/folderWorkspaces/worktrees; runContext carries logical project+host identity; history reads address local runtime explicitly.
pushRows.disposal: Preload paired on/removeListener (bridge 47-52). Hook effect [] returns ipcRenderer.removeListener disposer (unmount). Late/duplicate pushes: each carries a fresh single-use dispatchToken; token map dedups via begin/reservation and 30-min expiry; handler itself has no sequence counter — repeated delivery of the same request object would re-dispatch (token reservation at completion time is the only guard, downstream).
pushRows.priorNamedPayload: AutomationDispatchRequest = {automation: Automation, run: AutomationRun, dispatchToken: string} (automations-types.ts). Automation: id/name/prompt/precheck/agentId/runContext/sourceContext/projectId(legacy)/workspaceMode existing|new_per_run/workspaceId/baseBranch/setupDecision/reuseSession/timezone/rrule/dtstart/enabled/missedRunGraceMinutes/botId. AutomationRun: id/automationId/title/scheduledFor/trigger/status pending|dispatching|dispatched|completed|skipped_*|dispatch_failed/workspace fields. dispatchToken: randomUUID, single record {automationId, runId, expiresAt +30min, reservedBy?, inFlight} (dispatch-tokens.ts:23-36). No omission: all three keys always present on the wire.

onCreateTerminal: (
    callback: (data: {
      requestId?: string
      worktreeId: string
      command?: string
      cwd?: string
      env?: Record<string, string>
      launchConfig?: SleepingAgentLaunchConfig
      resumeProviderSession?: AgentProviderSessionMetadata
      launchToken?: string
      launchAgent?: TuiAgent
      viewMode?: 'terminal' | 'chat'
      title?: string
      ptyId?: string
      activate?: boolean
      focus?: boolean
      presentation?: RuntimeTerminalPresentation
      surfaceOwner?: false
      tabId?: string
      leafId?: string
      splitFromLeafId?: string
      splitDirection?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
      splitTelemetrySource?: TerminalPaneSplitSource
    }) => void
  ): (() => void) => {
    const listener = (
      _event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent,
      data: {
        requestId?: string
        worktreeId: string
        command?: string
        cwd?: string
        env?: Record<string, string>
        launchConfig?: SleepingAgentLaunchConfig
        resumeProviderSession?: AgentProviderSessionMetadata
        launchToken?: string
        launchAgent?: TuiAgent
        viewMode?: 'terminal' | 'chat'
        title?: string
        ptyId?: string
        activate?: boolean
        focus?: boolean
        presentation?: RuntimeTerminalPresentation
        surfaceOwner?: false
        tabId?: string
        leafId?: string
        splitFromLeafId?: string
        splitDirection?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
        splitTelemetrySource?: TerminalPaneSplitSource
      }
    ) => callback(data)
    ipcRenderer.on('ui:createTerminal', listener)
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('ui:createTerminal', listener)
  }

  id: string

  sourceContext?: TaskSourceContext | null

  status: AutomationRunStatus

   *  is deleted and its live metadata is gone. */
  workspaceDisplayName?: string | null
  sessionKind: 'terminal'
  chatSessionId: string | null
  terminalSessionId: string | null
  /** Why: a terminal tab can later point at a different pane/PTY. Automation
   *  run reopening must target the pane that actually executed the run. */
  terminalPaneKey: string | null
  terminalPtyId: string | null

  precheckResult: AutomationPrecheckResult | null
  usage: AutomationRunUsage | null
  error: string | null
  startedAt: number | null
  dispatchedAt: number | null
  createdAt: number
  /** Why: run titles must stay unique once retention prunes old runs, so the
   *  number can no longer be derived from how many runs are currently kept. */
  runNumber?: number
  /** Why: a target that cannot resolve refuses every occurrence, so consecutive
   *  identical refusals fold into this record instead of one row each. Counts the
   *  occurrences the record stands for; absent means one. */
  occurrenceCount?: number
  /** `scheduledFor` of the most recently folded occurrence; absent until one folds. */
  lastOccurrenceAt?: number
}

      worktree: await runtime.updateManagedWorktreeMeta(params.worktree, {
        displayName: params.displayName,

          ? { displayNameIsPinned: displayNameUpdatePinsLabel(params.displayName) }
          : {}),

        linkedGitLabIssue: params.linkedGitLabIssue,
        linkedBitbucketPR: params.linkedBitbucketPR,
        linkedAzureDevOpsPR: params.linkedAzureDevOpsPR,
        linkedGiteaPR: params.linkedGiteaPR,
        linkedWorkItem: params.linkedWorkItem,
        linkedTaskSourceContext: params.linkedTaskSourceContext,
        comment: params.comment,
        isArchived: params.isArchived,
        isUnread: params.isUnread,
        isPinned: params.isPinned,
        sortOrder: params.sortOrder,
        manualOrder: params.manualOrder,
        lastActivityAt: params.lastActivityAt,
        createdAt: params.createdAt,
        sparseDirectories: params.sparseDirectories,
        sparseBaseRef: params.sparseBaseRef,
        sparsePresetId: params.sparsePresetId,
        baseRef: params.baseRef,
        workspaceStatus: params.workspaceStatus,
        pushTarget: params.pushTarget,
        diffComments: params.diffComments,
        mobileDiffReview: params.mobileDiffReview,
        lineage:
          params.parentWorktree || params.noParent === true
            ? {
                parentWorktree: params.parentWorktree,
                noParent: params.noParent === true
              }
            : undefined
      } as Parameters<typeof runtime.updateManagedWorktreeMeta>[1])

Callbacks inserted BEFORE invoke; mismatched response ID or invoke rejection removes current map entry. Response/binary route to callbacks; error is non-terminal and retains entry. Close deletes entry and releases idle listener BEFORE calling onClose. unsubscribe always invokes runtimeEnvironments:unsubscribe for its ID even if already removed; only local dispatcher/listener removal waits for the last map entry. sendBinary sends subscriptionBinary. ID uses crypto.randomUUID, with Date.now/Math.random fallback. Source behavior only, not proof remote errors/cancellation handled end-to-end.
